originalTitle: Saçın nereye uzanacağını nasıl bildiğine dair gizem nihayet çözülmüş olabilir
titleEn: The mystery of how hair knows where to grow may finally be solved
headline: Saçın nereye uzanacağını nasıl bildiğine dair gizem nihayet çözülmüş olabilir.
details: Scientists have discovered that the intricate patterns of hair follicles on mammals may arise from a remarkably simple process involving cells following chemical signals.
brief: Long before a mammal is born, its skin begins establishing the precise locations where hair will eventually grow. These developing hair follicles form intricate geometric arrangements that differ from species to species.
summary: Long before a mammal is born, its skin begins establishing the precise locations where hair will eventually grow. These developing hair follicles form intricate geometric arrangements that differ from species to species. But what determines where each follicle appears, and how does the body create such orderly patterns? Researchers at the University of Geneva (UNIGE) have identified a surprisingly simple process that may help explain this biological mystery.
